title: Siege of Alkmaar
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Alkmaar", at revision 1370738744, opens: "The siege of Alkmaar (1573) was a turning point in the Eighty Years' War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2350145, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1573 battle of the Eighty Years' War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
